verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents Directory Insights, which aggregates and standardizes event logs across user activity and IT resources, and says directory events data can be managed and exported through RESTful commands. Together these cover a structured, API-accessible event log, but the pack has no evidence of native SIEM streaming. missing for 10: native streaming/forwarding to SIEMs, detail on event coverage (whether every identity event is captured), query capabilities and log API docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
